quotes.text: The patented business model of this app is looking for or a small team (tech + business) to re-fresh existing MVP. MUST have fundraising capability (angel/pre-seed level). The easiest way to create a restaurant deal, is let the guest say 'how much' they'll spend and 'when' (today). That's actually an RFB, isn't it? This IP moves electrons, not soggy fries. I'm the 71-year old inventor and patent holder. I'm open to JV, acquisition, or exclusive licensing. Jeff@LessEat.com
